text: dsh-metacog 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的元认知监控插件，通过 Cordis 挂载并注册项目目标、活动检查和报告等工具，同时提供浏览器设置卡。它把项目目标组织成可确认和编辑的目标树，记录会话中的工具活动并判断是否偏离目标，也支持观察矛盾、处理干预和生成周期报告。适合希望在长时间开发会话中持续核对工作方向、查看项目活动摘要的 DSH 用户。配置从宿主传入；覆盖设置可选用环境变量指定文件路径。

dsh-metacog is a Cordis plugin for the DSH web client. It registers tools to edit project goal trees, check activity drift, observe contradictions, and create periodic reports. A browser card displays settings and reports. It helps users track project direction during long DSH sessions.
想让 DSH 记住项目当前目标，并提醒我长会话是否逐渐跑偏。
我需要把项目目标拆成可编辑的树，再对照实际工具活动检查进度。
I want periodic factual summaries of project activity and files touched during DSH work.
dsh-metacog 的功能「目标树与漂移监测」：通过注册的目标树工具建立、确认和编辑项目目标，并收集会话活动供检查工具判断当前工作是否偏离目标。
dsh-metacog 的功能「项目周期报告」：插件可生成日报、周报和月报，并由设置卡展示报告；报告用于汇总项目活动与文件变化。

dsh-metacog README · dsh-metacog：**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（dsh）加一层元认知监控：把「这个会话到底在为什么目标干活」显式建模成一棵目标树，把「哪些结构性张力在拖慢它」建模成一棵矛盾树，然后用工具调用的真实轨迹去判定当前活动是否还在服务目标，跑偏就出卡片。

插件以 Cordis 插件形式挂进 dsh profile，服务端跑分析，前端提供树编辑与设置卡。

dsh-metacog README · 它解决的问题：长会话里模型很容易越走越偏：一开始要做的是 A，十几轮之后在忙 B，而没有任何一处地方记录过 A 还在不在。事后回看，只有一堆工具调用，没有一个可对照的基准。

dsh-metacog 把基准写下来（目标树 + 判据），然后每一步都拿轨迹去对：

- 目标树：L0 根目标 → L1 → …，每个叶子节点带可检查的完成判据（`successCriteria`）和活动对齐规则（`relevantActivities` / `allowedMethods` / `excludedActivities`）
- 矛盾树：区分 core（结构性、不会靠努力消失）与 main（当前最限制进展的那一个），带强度读数和由观测历史推算的趋势
- 漂移判定：活动被分成 `aligned` / `exploratory` / `scope_drift` / `uncertain`，只有 A 级证据才升级成打断卡片
- 周期产出：日报 / 周报 / 月报，只陈述事实——动了哪些目录、产生了哪些文件、各自占多少时间，不给建议

dsh-metacog README · 工具：服务端注册 20 个工具：

| 分组 | 工具 |
|---|---|
| 目标树 | `goal_tree_init` `goal_tree_confirm` `goal_tree_view` `goal_tree_edit` `generate_report` |
| 矛盾树 | `contradiction_observe` `contradiction_tree_edit` |
| 判定 | `check_drift` `resolve_intervention` |
| 计划 | `metacog_declare_plan` `metacog_revise_plan` |
| 其他 | `metacog_scan` `metacog_draft_criteria` `metacog_merge_tree` `metacog_revise` `metacog_archive` `metacog_archive_milestone` `metacog_purge` `metacog_read_document` `metacog_ask_user` |
dsh-metacog README · 工具：另有 Web 端 HTTP 端点（`metacog/tree`、`metacog/settings`、`metacog/reports`、`metacog/verdicts` 等 17 个），以及一个手写的 Web 设置卡 `client.js`。

dsh-metacog README · 安装：插件未发布到 npm registry，按本地目录挂载：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-account>/dsh-metacog.git
cd dsh-metacog
npm install
npm run build

然后在 dsh profile（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`）下，把包目录挂进 `node_modules`，并在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里插入挂载行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-metacog
      name: dsh-metacog
```

Windows 下用目录 junction 比复制更省事：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-metacog" `
  -Target "D:\path\to\dsh-metacog"
```
dsh-metacog README · 安装：重启 dsh 后生效。

```yaml
- id: dsh-metacog
  name: dsh-metacog
  config:
    schedule:

设置卡也可写入 `~/.dsh/metacog-overrides.yml`；两处等价，改完都需重启生效。

dsh-metacog README · 数据落在哪：每个项目的数据写在 `<project>/.metacog/` 下：`activities/`（活动流）、`signals/`（判定信号）、`audit/`（哈希链审计，append-only）、`snapshots/`（目标树快照）、`reports/`、`state/`。

跨工作区的汇总报告在 `~/.dsh/metacog-global/`。项目注册表在 `~/.dsh/metacog-projects.json`。

这些都是运行时数据，不随源码分发；`.metacog/` 已在 `.gitignore` 中排除。

dsh-metacog README · 开发：```bash
npm run build        # tsc 编译 src/ → lib/
npm run check:fresh  # 校验构建产物是否落后于源码
npm test             # 单元测试
npm run test:all     # 全量测试（含验收、集成、行为追踪）

源码在 `src/`（60 个文件，纯 ESM TypeScript），编译产物在 `lib/`。`client.js` 是手写 JS，不经构建。

dsh-metacog README · dsh-metacog：A metacognitive monitor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (dsh).

It makes explicit what a session is actually working toward — as a **goal tree** — and which structural tensions are slowing it down — as a **contradiction tree** — then judges every step against real tool-call traces, surfacing a card when the work drifts away.

Ships as a Cordis plugin inside a dsh profile: analysis runs server-side, with a web settings card and tree editor on the client.

dsh-metacog README · The problem it addresses：Long sessions drift. You start on A, and a dozen turns later you are busy with B, and nothing anywhere recorded whether A still mattered. Looking back, there is only a pile of tool calls and no baseline to compare against.

dsh-metacog writes the baseline down, then checks each step against it:

dsh-metacog README · The problem it addresses：- **Goal tree** — L0 root → L1 → …, where every leaf carries checkable `successCriteria` and activity-alignment rules (`relevantActivities` / `allowedMethods` / `excludedActivities`)
- **Contradiction tree** — distinguishes `core` tensions (structural; they do not vanish by trying harder) from the `main` one currently limiting progress, with intensity readings and a trend computed from observation history
- **Drift judgement** — every activity is classified `aligned` / `exploratory` / `scope_drift` / `uncertain`; only grade-A evidence escalates to an interrupting card
- **Periodic reports** — daily / weekly / monthly, stating only facts: which directories were touched, which files were produced, how much time each group covers. Never advice.

dsh-metacog README · Tools：| Group | Tools |
|---|---|
| Goal tree | `goal_tree_init` `goal_tree_confirm` `goal_tree_view` `goal_tree_edit` `generate_report` |
| Contradiction tree | `contradiction_observe` `contradiction_tree_edit` |
| Judgement | `check_drift` `resolve_intervention` |
| Planning | `metacog_declare_plan` `metacog_revise_plan` |
| Other | `metacog_scan` `metacog_draft_criteria` `metacog_merge_tree` `metacog_revise` `metacog_archive` `metacog_archive_milestone` `metacog_purge` `metacog_read_document` `metacog_ask_user` |
dsh-metacog README · Tools：There are also 17 web HTTP endpoints (`metacog/tree`, `metacog/settings`, `metacog/reports`, `metacog/verdicts`, …) and a hand-written settings card, `client.js`.

dsh-metacog README · Install：Not published to npm. Mount it from a local directory.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-metacog.git
cd dsh-metacog
npm install
npm run build

Then, inside your dsh profile (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`), place the package under `node_modules` and insert the mount row into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-metacog
      name: dsh-metacog
```

On Windows a directory junction is easier than copying:

dsh-metacog README · Install：```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-metacog" `
  -Target "D:\path\to\dsh-metacog"
```

Restart dsh to load it.

dsh-metacog README · Configuration：Runtime config lives under the plugin's `config` in `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-metacog
  name: dsh-metacog
  config:
    schedule:

The settings card can also write `~/.dsh/metacog-overrides.yml`. Both are equivalent and require a restart.

dsh-metacog README · Where data lives：Per-project data is written under `<project>/.metacog/`: `activities/` (activity stream), `signals/` (judgement signals), `audit/` (append-only hash-chained audit log), `snapshots/` (goal tree snapshots), `reports/`, `state/`.

Cross-workspace summary reports go to `~/.dsh/metacog-global/`; the project registry is `~/.dsh/metacog-projects.json`.

All of it is runtime data and is not distributed with the source. `.metacog/` is excluded via `.gitignore`.

npm run build        # tsc: src/ -> lib/
npm run check:fresh  # verify build artifacts are not stale
npm test             # unit tests
npm run test:all     # full suite (acceptance, integration, behaviour tracking)

Source is in `src/` (60 files, pure ESM TypeScript); build output in `lib/`. `client.js` is hand-written JS and is never compiled.

dsh-metacog README · Limitations：- Implements the Cordis plugin contract, not a generic npm middleware — it will not run outside a dsh host
- `src/evidence/pdf.ts` needs an external `python` (or `python3`) with `pypdf`; without it, only PDF evidence extraction is affected
- `package.json` is marked `private: true` on purpose, to prevent accidental publishing
- No release-versioning semantics yet; `0.1.0` is the initial version
